item.carmod.car.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Right-click the car to drive. WASD to drive, Shift to get out, punch to pick it up.
item.carmod.loader.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. While driving, press B to lower or raise the bucket. Lowered, driving forward flattens the road five blocks high. Raised, it drives like a car.
item.carmod.dump_truck.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. While driving, it picks up dropped items in a wide area around it. Press V to dump. A container behind the tailgate is filled; otherwise the load drops behind the truck.
item.carmod.drill.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Press G to cycle the bore: 15°, 30°, 45°, or straight down. Hold forward to dig a tunnel, and reverse to back out. Raised, it drives like a car.
item.carmod.amphibious.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Drives on land and on water, and can go from the bank into the water or back up onto shore.
item.carmod.racer.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Much faster than the car. Hold space and turn to drift.
item.carmod.helicopter.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. After you board, the rotor has to reach flight speed before it will lift off. That takes a few seconds. W to go forward, A and D to turn, space to climb, Ctrl to descend. It hovers when you let go. Shift to get out. Hitting a wall, or hitting something at high speed, blows it up.
item.carmod.armed_helicopter.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Flies like the helicopter. Press R to fire a missile at a creature standing on the ground ahead. It locks on and follows.
item.carmod.jet.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Throttle stays where you leave it. Space adds power, Ctrl cuts it. On the ground, A and D steer, and S pulls the nose up once you are fast enough. In the air, W noses down, S noses up, and holding A or D rolls you all the way upside down. It stays where you leave it. You and the camera stay fixed to the jet. Too slow and it stalls. Hold X to fire the cannon. R launches a missile. Hitting a wall, the ground, or water blows it up. Shift to get out.
item.carmod.nuke.tooltip: Right-click a block to place. Walk away, then press N to detonate it from anywhere in the same dimension. The blast radius is 64 blocks and it digs a crater. Punch it to pick it back up.
message.carmod.nuke.armed: Nuke placed. Press N to detonate
block.carmod.traffic_light.tooltip: Right-click with an empty hand to change how long red and green stay on. Yellow stays on for 2 seconds.
block.carmod.shield.tooltip: Place it in front of or beside a road paver, facing the same way. When the paver gets a redstone signal, they move together. Blocks in front are dug and put in the chest behind.
block.carmod.road_paver.tooltip: Place it facing forward, in front of a chest. A redstone signal starts it, and it pulls any same-facing shield borers along.
block.carmod.road_paver.tooltip2: Right-click with an empty hand to change the width. It pulls asphalt from the chest behind, up to 128 blocks. Breaking and replacing it resets the count.
